description: This file defines an interface for configuring persistent streams within the Orleans framework, along with extension methods to simplify configuration of various stream components such as pulling agents, lifecycle, partition balancing, and backoff providers.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for the ISiloPersistentStreamConfigurator interface to facilitate configuration tasks.

methods.name: ConfigurePullingAgent
methods.description: Configures the pulling agent with optional configuration options.

methods.name: ConfigureLifecycle
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle of the stream.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitionBalancing
methods.description: Sets up partition balancing using a factory method.

methods.name: ConfigureBackoffProvider
methods.description: Configures the message delivery backoff provider.

methods.name: ConfigureBackoffProvider
methods.description: Configures the queue reader backoff provider.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitionBalancing
methods.description: Sets up partition balancing with specific options via a factory and configuration delegate.
